name: Cua mat trang
summary: A crab with red spots on its shell like a moon. Islanders say the meat is sweet and firm, and richer in minerals than other crabs, in the week of the rising moon.
origin: Côn Đảo. Báo Đồng Nai, 11 July 2025.
culture: The shells are also kept as decoration.
taste: Sweet and firm in the week of the rising moon, and richer in minerals than other crabs, according to the islanders Báo Đồng Nai spoke to.
howToEat: Order it as a seafood plate at a seaside restaurant.
where: Seaside restaurants in town, per Báo Điện Biên Phủ, 31 July 2026.
seoTitle: Cua mat trang — moon crab in Con Dao
seoDescription: Cua mặt trăng is the Côn Đảo moon crab, red-spotted, with meat islanders say is sweet and firm in the week of the rising moon.
